{{Quote|See, all I need you to do is to take this package out to some friends of mine on the outskirts of town.|[[Dunir Signos]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:SD" />}}
'''Toggi Bok''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] who lived on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He was known to do business with [[Jabba's criminal empire/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]]. Sometime following [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], Jabba's employee [[Dunir Signos]] tasked a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] with delivering a package to Bok, who at the [[Time/Legends|time]] was with several Trandoshans at a small camp just outside of [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]].<ref name="SWG:SD" />

==Behind the scenes==
Toggi Bok appeared as a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:SD" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Toggi Bok was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Legacy Quest|Legacy Quest]]" with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
